110:1: How does the spirit of God within my mind lead me toward eternity while respecting my freedom?
110:4: From Paper 107 to Paper 109 we looked at where the Thought Adjusters come from, what their nature is, and what career they follow in the universe. Now Paper 110 turns its gaze to the relationship the Adjuster forms with one person—the individual mortal.
110:5: The presenter says that giving freedom to imperfect beings brings unavoidable tragedy, but that the perfect God shares that suffering in loving companionship (110:0.1). And he confesses that the devotion of an Adjuster to an individual is the most truly divine affection in all creation, and that nowhere in the universe of universes is there a ministry that can compare with it (110:0.2).
110:6: So what does this divine indweller do within our minds, and how does he co-operate with our free will to lead us to eternal fusion?
110:8: ⟦Q 110:2.1⟧The Adjusters respect your sovereignty of personality; they are always subservient to your will.⟦/Q⟧ (110:2.1)
110:12: The Adjuster does not live in the physical organ of the brain; he indwells the mortal mind. And he communicates constantly, even when we are not aware of it, especially when the mind makes contact with the spirit in the superconscious in an attitude of worship (110:1.1). The presenter calls the Adjusters tireless workers, safe guides, and patient teachers, and he hopes we will love them more and co-operate with them more (110:1.2).
110:13: The Adjuster’s chief concern is spiritual preparation for the next stage, but he is not indifferent to our health, happiness, and true prosperity (110:1.3-1.4). The Adjuster stays with us through every disaster and illness that does not destroy the mind. 110:20: Fear, anger, envy, jealousy, suspicion, intolerance — they interfere with the soul’s spiritual progress

No human being is ever spiritualized against his will, and survival is a gift we receive only if we desire it (110:2.2).

The Adjuster is devoted to building the spiritual counterpart of our career, the morontia transcript (110:2.3-2.4). 110:38: This co-operation does not mean self-torture or mock piety. The ideal life is one of loving service, not fearful apprehension (110:3.4). Confusion, discouragement, ignorance, and even doubt do not prevent survival; only conscious resistance to the Adjuster’s leading does (110:3.5). The presenter offers four ways to consciously promote harmony with the Adjuster (110:3.6-3.10).
110:43: Basing life on truth, beauty, and goodness
110:45: Recognizing the divine fatherhood and worshiping lovingly
110:47: Recognizing brotherhood and sincerely serving one’s fellows
110:49: Realizing obligations to the Supreme Being — the birth of cosmic morality
110:52: The Adjuster is in constant contact with the information of the universe, but because our natures have so little in common, he can pass little of that wisdom on to our minds (110:4.1). We cannot distinguish the products of our own intellect from those of the Adjuster’s joint activity. Most sudden ideas are ordinary mental processes in which submerged ideas rise to the surface, and the Adjuster’s revelations appear not through the subconscious but through the superconscious (110:4.2-4.3).
110:53: The races of Urantia are on the whole so electrically and chemically controlled and so emotional that it is extremely difficult for the Adjusters to guide them. Even flashes of new truth easily produce fanaticism or intellectual upheaval, and many strange “isms” have arisen from distorted Adjuster communications (110:4.5). The book cites records showing that the number of those who can function safely with self-acting Adjusters has been declining, and says that the planetary supervisors are proposing measures to preserve the higher spiritual types (110:4.6).
110:55: The Adjuster must not be confused with conscience. ⟦Q 110:5.1⟧Conscience is a human and purely psychic reaction.⟦/Q⟧ Conscience exhorts us to do right, but the Adjuster tries to tell us what truly is right (110:5.1).
110:65: Seeks to tell us what truly is right
110:67: It is also dangerous to take dreams for the voice of the Adjuster. Disordered dreams show rather that the Adjuster has failed to harmonize the elements of the mind, and ordinary dream experiences are purely physiologic and psychologic phenomena (110:5.2-5.5). It is also dangerous to treat every new idea that comes to mind as the Adjuster’s dictation. It is better to err in taking an expression of the Adjuster for a human experience than to blunder into exalting a reaction of the human mind to divine dignity (110:5.5-5.6).

Conquering the circles is not fusion itself, but a preparation for it (110:6.1). To pass through the circles, body, mind, and spirit must grow in harmony; if the intellect alone races ahead, or spiritual development goes to extremes, communication with the Adjuster becomes difficult and dangerous (110:6.3-6.4).
110:73: Every decision we make either hinders or helps the Adjuster’s function, and not only the weight of decisions but also their repetition matters (110:6.6). The conquest of the circles shows itself in three ways (110:6.7-6.10).

110:80: The emergence of the morontia soul shows the degree of conquest
110:82: The higher the circles, the more real the selfhood becomes
110:88: Ability of moral choice developed; the Adjuster received — a potential citizen of the local universe
110:90: A personal seraphic guardian assigned; the Adjuster’s work far more effective
110:92: Relative mortal maturity; some degree of direct communication with the Adjuster

The great days in an Adjuster’s career are when the subject breaks through the third circle, when he reaches the first circle, and when they are eternally fused (110:6.22).

When this happens during life in the flesh, the body is instantly consumed, and to onlookers it appears that the person vanishes “⟦Q 110:7.2⟧in chariots of fire⟦/Q⟧” (110:7.2). After fusion, the Adjuster and the soul become one being, each possessing all the experiences and values of the other (110:7.4-7.5).
110:97: But for most people the Adjuster must wait patiently for the deliverance of death. Because of our material nature, the ears of the human mind are almost deaf to the broadcasts of love (110:7.6-7.8). The presenter closes the paper by sharing a plea that one Adjuster sent to its human partner, a member of the reserve corps of destiny. The Adjuster promises to be faithful to the very end and appeals to his subject to survive and not disappoint him (110:7.10).
110:99: ⟦Q 110:7.10⟧On the human will our achievement of personality depends.⟦/Q⟧ (110:7.10)
110:102: Paper 110 shows us the Adjuster within us at close range. The Adjuster comes with a perfect plan but never violates our will; he works only through our decisions and faith. His voice is easily confused with conscience, with dreams, and with every passing thought, so humble discernment is needed—yet even confusion and ignorance do not prevent survival; only conscious resistance does. As we climb the psychic circles through repeated decisions, the Adjuster impresses himself ever more clearly on our minds, and at last in fusion the two become one forever. In the end, all of that achievement depends on our choice.
110:107: The Adjuster indwells the mind, not the brain, and cares about our whole life
110:109: The Adjuster brings a perfect plan but is always subservient to our will
110:113: The Adjuster’s revelations come through the superconscious, not the subconscious
110:115: Do not take conscience or dreams for the Adjuster’s voice
110:117: Repeated decisions lift us through the circles into closer attunement
110:119: Fusion comes through complete attunement of the mortal will with God’s will
110:122: The Adjuster respects our freedom to the very end, and becomes one with us as far as we choose his will.
111:1: What is the soul that is born where the spirit of God meets my mind, and how does it grow?
111:4: In Paper 110 we saw how the Adjuster works within the mind of the individual mortal. Now Paper 111 moves on to the fruit of that co-operation: the soul, which is born and grows between the Adjuster and the human mind.
111:5: Because the Adjuster is within the mind, neither science nor philosophy can ever satisfactorily understand the human soul. The soul is a child of the universe and can be known only by cosmic insight and spiritual discovery (111:0.1). The idea of a soul and an indwelling spirit is not new; it appears in many beliefs, such as the Hindu atman, the Chinese yang and yin, and the Egyptian ka and ba (111:0.2-0.4). Many Egyptians even believed that the ka was “⟦Q 111:0.6⟧an oracle from God in everybody⟦/Q⟧” (111:0.6).
111:6: So what exactly is the soul, and what part do our choices and our inner life play in its growth?
111:8: ⟦Q 111:1.9⟧Mind is your ship, the Adjuster is your pilot, the human will is captain.⟦/Q⟧ (111:1.9)
111:12: The Adjuster’s work is spiritual, but it must all be done on an intellectual foundation. Mind is the human soil in which the Adjuster, co-operating with the personality, grows the soul (111:1.1). The material mind is the arena in which human beings make their decisions, choose or forsake God, and eternalize or destroy themselves (111:1.3).
111:13: Evolution provided the body and the Father gave the Adjuster, but the mind has been placed in our hands. By mind we live or die (111:1.4). What matters is not so much what the mind comprehends now as what it desires to comprehend, not so much what we are today as what we are becoming day by day (111:1.5). The Adjuster pilots the mind but never dominates it against our will (111:1.8).
111:24: The morontia harbors of eternal survival, and the Paradise Father
111:27: The material mind of the mortal is the cosmic loom, and on the morontia fabric strung upon it the Adjuster weaves the patterns of a character of enduring values and divine meanings. The character thus woven is the surviving soul (111:2.2). The relationship of mind and spirit is not a simple combination of two factors; it produces an entirely new and unique universe value (111:2.3).
111:29: Three antecedent factors of the soul
111:32: That mind and all the cosmic influences acting on it
111:34: The Adjuster and all the spiritual influences related to human life
111:36: Neither material nor spiritual but morontial — this is the soul
111:38: The midway creatures have called this soul the “mid-mind,” lying between the material mind and the cosmic mind (111:2.8). The soul is the joint offspring of a mind directed by a human will that longs to know God and of the Adjuster, an actual fragment of God (111:2.10).
111:40: The mistakes and wrong deeds of the mind can delay the evolution of the soul, but they cannot stop it once it has begun. The mortal does, however, have the power at any time to revoke that choice and refuse survival, and until fusion with the Adjuster he can forsake the Father’s will (111:3.1). During life the will is within the circuits of the material mind, but as it grows it becomes more and more identified with the soul, and after the resurrection it is wholly identified with the morontia self (111:3.2).
111:41: Mortal life is not so much a period of probation as a process of education (111:3.5). Mind knows quantity and meaning, but quality—value—is felt (111:3.6). The more the soul is filled with truth, beauty, and goodness, the more indestructible its being becomes (111:3.7).
111:43: ⟦Q 111:3.7⟧What you begin in time you will assuredly finish in eternity—if it is worth finishing.⟦/Q⟧ (111:3.7)
111:46: Recognition is fitting sensory impressions into memory patterns; understanding is organizing them into a network of principles; and meaning arises from the union of the two. Meanings and values are perceived only in the inner, supermaterial realm (111:4.1-4.2). Every real advance of civilization is born in this inner world, and only the inner life is truly creative (111:4.3).
111:56: Creativity most subject to our direction
111:58: Materialistic pursuits alone cannot bring progress
111:59: The birthplace of all true progress
111:61: Today the world is led by people who are rich in ideas but poor in ideals, and this is the cause of poverty, divorce, war, and racial hatred (111:4.10). Creativity can also turn into destructiveness: evil is creativity gone awry, and every conflict is a civil war within the personality (111:4.11). The past cannot be changed, but the future can be changed by the present creativity of the inner self (111:4.12).
111:63: Doing the will of God is the expression of a willingness to share one’s inner life with God. To share is to be divine (111:5.1). God first entrusted a part of himself to us and consented to indwell us in subjection to the human will (111:5.3-5.4).
111:64: So choosing the Father’s will is not a surrender of will but a consecration of will, an expansion of will, a perfecting of will (111:5.5).
111:69: “⟦Q 111:5.6⟧Not my will but yours be done⟦/Q⟧”
111:71: “⟦Q 111:5.6⟧It is my will that your will be done⟦/Q⟧”
111:73: Fusion with the Adjuster; an eternal partnership of the wills of man and God
111:76: As part of nature, man is bound by nature, yet he can transcend it. He is finite, yet a spark of infinity dwells within him (111:6.1). Because of this dual nature, the courage to master nature can turn into the temptation of self-pride (111:6.2). But finiteness itself is not evil; evil and sin arise from the misuse and distortion of the finite (111:6.3).
111:77: We may discover the love of God without facts and the law of God without love, but we cannot understand the infinite balance of God until we unify the two in experience (111:6.6). Anxiety in the face of this paradox is natural, and only living faith can sustain man. And the greatest of all dangers is pride (111:6.8-6.10).
111:87: Self-pride and the deification of self-consciousness
111:90: The essence of the Paradise adventure is uncertainty together with security. In time and in mind we are uncertain, but in spirit and in eternity we are secure, trusting in the Father’s love (111:7.1). The Adjuster cannot stop the struggles of life or lessen its hardships, but if we allow him, he fights with us and for us, and he pictures for us the true purpose of the struggle (111:7.2-7.3).
111:91: The book explains that the races of Urantia are so complex a mixture of origins that the work of Adjusters and seraphim is made harder (111:7.4). One guardian of destiny testifies that in her subject ambition and indolence, high purpose and primitive urges, faith and fear were constantly in conflict. Even so, thanks to the Adjuster’s ever-present help, that soul achieved considerable happiness and success and ascended to the mansion worlds (111:7.5).
111:93: Paper 111 calmly explains where the soul comes from. Evolution gave the body and the Father gave the Adjuster, but the mind has been placed in our hands. On the loom of that mind our choices and the Adjuster’s labors meet, and a new reality, the soul, is woven. The soul grows in the inner life, which is the seat of ideals and creativity as well as the place where pride and destructiveness lie in wait. Choosing the Father’s will is not giving up our will but consecrating and enlarging it, and though the Adjuster does not take away the hardships of life, he fights the battle with us and leads us safely through.
111:98: Mind is the ship, the Adjuster the pilot, the will the captain
111:100: The soul is a morontia reality born of the relationship of mind and spirit
111:102: Mortal life is a process of education, not probation
111:104: True creativity and ideals are born only in the inner life
111:106: Choosing the Father’s will is not surrender but consecration of will
111:108: For man, bound by nature yet transcending it, the greatest danger is pride
111:110: The Adjuster does not remove our hardships, but fights alongside us
111:113: The soul is the fabric of eternity woven by our choices and the Adjuster’s labors together, and when we choose the Father’s will, our will becomes most complete.
112:1: When death takes away body and mind, what part of me survives, and how am I awakened again?
112:4: In Papers 110 and 111 we saw how the Adjuster works within the mind and how the soul grows out of that co-operation. Now Paper 112 moves on to the greatest threshold of the journey: the question of death and survival.
112:5: Urantia is our starting point, and through every stage of growth there is one part of us that remains absolutely unchanged: personality, which persists in the midst of change (112:0.1). The presenter says it would be presumptuous to attempt a definition of personality, yet he sets out fourteen known facts about it (112:0.2-0.16). Looking at only a few of them shows what a unique gift personality is.
112:6: So how does this personality pass through death, and what survives to awaken again on the mansion worlds?
112:8: ⟦Q 112:5.20⟧Human life is an endless change of the factors of life unified by the stability of the unchanging personality.⟦/Q⟧ (112:5.20)
112:16: The Universal Father himself, or the Conjoint Actor acting for him
112:18: Not wholly bound by the fetters of antecedent causation
112:20: Unchanging in the presence of change
112:22: Dedicating the free will to doing the will of God
112:24: Absolutely unique; can associate but is not additive
112:26: Passes beyond death with identity in the surviving soul

112:33: Direction of progression — evolution, embracing meaning
112:37: Co-ordination and organization of selfhood — embracing insight

Man is by nature a social creature and does not function well in isolation (112:1.16). In an aggregation parts are added, but in a system they are arranged, and in the human system personality unifies all activities (112:1.19).
112:53: The fact that God became man has forever changed all the meanings and values of human personality. True love is the mutual regard of whole personalities (112:2.7). The very fact of having personality shows that man is a spiritual being, and even the materialist’s ability to deny supermaterial reality is evidence that cosmic consciousness is at work within him (112:2.9). The observer cannot be the thing observed (112:2.12).
112:58: The human self observes the material world
112:62: Experientially realizes the cosmic reality of the observation of the observation

112:71: Survival finally rejected — cosmically dead even though the body lives
112:73: The circuits of the volitional mind are irretrievably destroyed — the soul may survive according to earlier choices
112:75: When the life pulse of the brain stops, the Adjuster departs for Divinington

112:84: Joining the ranks of vanished Monitors for unrevealed service
112:88: Enrolling in the training schools of Divinington
112:90: Serving as student observers on the other six spheres of the Father
112:96: Choosing a world to serve on in case the subject rejected survival

112:100: Personality coming from the Father is eternal, but with regard to identity it is a conditioned eternity. Man must choose whether or not he will be present at the place where his destiny is achieved (112:5.2). Energy systems have no choice, but man is wholly involved in deciding his own destiny. The Adjuster is the way to Paradise, but that way must be walked by our own free will (112:5.3).
112:105: His eternal destiny depends on the integrity of the human will
112:107: His eternal personality depends on the sincerity of mortal free will
112:109: The realization of a new ascending son depends on the faithfulness of mortal choice
112:111: The actuality of evolution depends on the steadfastness and wisdom of decision-action
112:113: Those who through no fault of their own have not mastered the circles are given extended probation, and when there is doubt, the universe government always decides in the interest of the individual (112:5.6-5.7). Memories without spiritual meaning perish with the brain, but memories of the relationships between personalities have cosmic value and survive (112:5.22).

112:120: The mortal intellect perishes, but its meanings and values do not, and the creature will persists even though it loses the material intellect (112:6.4-6.5). For the memory patterns in the soul to come alive at once, the Adjuster is needed. Those who ascend without Adjusters regain their memories over a long time with the help of the seraphim (112:6.8).
112:125: The seven adjutant mind-spirits under the spirit of wisdom
112:127: Direct contact with the cosmic mind as modified by the Divine Minister
112:129: The direct ministry of the cosmic mind of Orvonton
112:132: Fusion gives the personality eternal actualities: the fixing of the qualities of divinity, the experience and memory of past eternity, immortality, and more (112:7.1). Fusion never occurs until the superuniverse has declared that the human has made an irrevocable choice for the eternal career (112:7.5).
112:141: A value secure in the universe — proved by fusion
112:143: It is not that the Adjuster gains personality or that the human gains immortality; together they form a new ascending personality (112:7.9). By fusion the Father has fulfilled his promise to give himself to man, and these fused finaliters are believed destined to administer the future universes of outer space (112:7.14, 7.17).
112:145: If you actually will, if you really desire, surely the heritage of the ages is yours. (112:7.19)

When death comes, the Adjuster departs carrying our memories, the soul sleeps in the guardian’s care, and on the mansion worlds the two meet again and awaken us. What has no spiritual meaning perishes, but our relationships with those we have loved remain. The universe government extends mercy to guarantee everyone one genuine opportunity, and when at last we are eternally fused with the Adjuster, the partnership of God and man becomes a oneness that no one can undo.
112:153: Personality is the Father’s gift, unchanging through every change
112:155: The surviving self moves the seat of its identity from the body to the soul

112:159: The Adjuster carries our memories and prepares for reunion on Divinington
112:161: Personality is eternal, but whether we share in its destiny is our choice
112:163: On the mansion worlds the true personality emerges like a butterfly
112:165: Through fusion God and man become one, never to be separated

113:1: Who is the guardian angel who watches over me all my life, and how does that angel go with me even beyond death?

In Urantia’s past, the only angels known were almost entirely these guardians of destiny, and many revelations came “⟦Q 113:0.1⟧by the ministry of angels⟦/Q⟧” (113:0.1). 113:8: ⟦Q 113:7.7⟧For seraphim, the surest way of achieving the Paradise Deities is by successfully guiding a soul of evolutionary origin to the portals of Paradise.⟦/Q⟧ (113:7.7)
113:12: The teaching about guardian angels is not a myth. Jesus himself said that the angels of the little ones always behold the presence of the Father (113:1.1). 113:17: A company of seraphim ministers together with a battalion of cherubim
113:19: Assigned in seven groups according to circle attainment
113:21: A personal seraphim assigned as soon as one is enrolled in the reserve corps of destiny

113:30: A seraphic pair guides groups of five hundred
113:32: A seraphic pair takes charge of about one hundred
113:34: A seraphic pair takes charge of groups of ten
113:36: A personal pair of angels wholly devoted to one person

113:47: Recorder of the undertaking — the recording angel of the evolutionary world

The Adjuster is the presence of the Father, and the Spirit of Truth is the presence of the Sons; the seraphim unify these divine endowments on the lower levels of human experience (113:3.3).
113:57: Co-ordinators who personalize the impersonal ministries
113:59: Correlators of mind and morontia — interpreters
113:61: Manipulate the environment together with the physical controllers and midway creatures
113:63: That is why seraphim become the custodians of the mind patterns, memory formulas, and soul between death and resurrection (113:3.4). 113:65: Seraphim are mind stimulators, constantly striving to lead human beings to make the decisions that bring about circle progress. But they do not work from within, as the Adjuster does; they work from without inward, through the social, ethical, and moral environment (113:4.1).

113:72: The personal agent of the ministry of the Infinite Spirit
113:75: From without inward, through the environment
113:77: The essence of the eternal nature
113:78: The teacher of the evolving nature

Adjusters and seraphim seem to have no communication with each other, yet they always work in perfect harmony, and the guardians are most active when the Adjuster is least active (113:4.5).

114:1: Urantia has been isolated by rebellion—so who governs it behind the scenes, and how?
114:4: In Paper 113 we met the guardian of destiny who watches over a single person. Now Paper 114 widens the view to show how seraphim care for and govern an entire planet. 114:6: So under whose hand is this isolated world, which has neither a Planetary Prince nor an Adam, and why do we have no need to feel forsaken?
114:12: The sovereignty of Urantia was first held by the System Sovereign of Satania and then delegated to a joint commission of Melchizedeks and Life Carriers. 114:13: But Michael does not govern the planet directly; he set up a commission of twenty-four former Urantians on Jerusem. 115:4: Paper 115 is one of the densest papers in the whole Urantia Book. Unfamiliar words come one after another, but they all point to a single question: since there is a perfect and infinite God, why is there another Deity who is not yet complete, who is still growing?

115:11: So the concept frames of the universe are true only relatively. **God is much, much more than a Father, but the Father is man’s highest concept of God** (115:1.2). The study of the Supreme Being begins with this honest admission.
